verdict.rationale: Mercury's own marketing says it syncs with QuickBooks, Xero or NetSuite and uses "AI-powered automations to close your books faster." The API and MCP also support transaction categories and categorizing transactions. Nothing explicitly says AI assigns GL codes automatically, and the category API on its own is only a building block. Missing for 10: explicit AI auto-assignment of GL codes or accounts, multi-entity support, mapping of Mercury categories to ledger accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
